title: AnkiLabs - AI
description: AI Card Actions calls through the LLM Proxy: outcomes, latency, input size, tokens and cost, with Usage Codes and spend from LiteLLM's database and the matching logs. Missing data is unknown, never zero.

panels.title: AI calls
panels.description: LLM calls over the dashboard range, one per action request and never retried, with activity over time. Window counts keep the first call after a restart and can be fractional.

panels.title: Error ratio
panels.description: Failed share of LLM calls over the dashboard range, as AnkiLabsAIErrorRatioHigh counts it: Usage Code errors and ai_refused excluded, ai_output_invalid included. Red from the alert's 20%; empty means no calls.

targets.expr: sum ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"}[$__range])) / (sum ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: p95 LLM duration (24h)
panels.description: 95th percentile LLM call time over the last 24 hours, both outcomes; empty with fewer than 5 calls. Buckets step 10, 30, 60, 120 s and calls time out at 75 s, so it is coarse above 10 s.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (namespace, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[24h]))) and on (namespace) sum by (namespace) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[24h])) >= 5

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: LLM cost in USD over the dashboard range as LiteLLM reported it, including answers rejected afterwards. Speech is priced per character.

panels.title: Tokens
panels.description: Prompt plus completion tokens over the dashboard range. Reasoning tokens are already part of completion, so they are not added; speech reports no tokens.

panels.title: Usage Codes
panels.description: Usage Codes that are neither blocked nor expired, and the budget they have left in total, from LiteLLM now (not the dashboard range). Codes without a budget add nothing to Budget left.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT blocked AND (expires IS NULL OR expires > now())) AS "Active",
  sum(remaining) FILTER (WHERE NOT blocked AND (expires IS NULL OR expires > now())) AS "Budget left"
FROM grafana.usage_codes

panels.title: Calls by action
panels.description: LLM calls per bar (hover for its time span), stacked by action (sentences, notes, review, speech) to the total. An answer rejected after LiteLLM returned it (ai_output_invalid) is still a call here.

panels.title: Error ratio by action (alert definition, 15m)
panels.description: Errors over all LLM calls in 15 minutes, excluding Usage Code errors and ai_refused, as in AnkiLabsAIErrorRatioHigh; the dashed line is its 20% threshold (it also needs at least 3 calls). Absent means no calls.

targets.expr: sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_errors_total{namespace="ankilabs",error_code!~"usage_code_.*|ai_refused"}[15m])) / (sum by (action) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"} offset 15m) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[15m])) > 0)

panels.title: Errors by code
panels.description: Failed LLM calls per bar stacked by error code, ai_timeout in red. ai_output_invalid is an answer rejected after LiteLLM returned it (success in its llm.request.completed log); usage_code_* and ai_refused (the model declined) are errors here but not in the alert.

panels.title: Scrape health
panels.description: Whether Prometheus could scrape AI Card Actions metrics: up or down per pod. A gap is unknown, not healthy; AnkiLabsScrapeFailed alerts on down.

panels.title: LLM duration distribution
panels.description: LLM calls per duration bucket and time slice, darker means more calls, both outcomes. Buckets step 10, 30, 60, 120 s and calls time out at 75 s, so timeouts land in the 60-120 s band; the first call after a pod restart can be missing.

panels.title: LLM duration p50 / p95 / p99 by action (30m window, at least 5 calls)
panels.description: Time from calling the LLM Proxy until the answer is accepted or rejected, both outcomes. Buckets step 10, 30, 60, 120 s and calls time out at 75 s, so upper percentiles are coarse; empty means fewer than 5 calls, not zero latency.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (action, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m]))) and on (action) sum by (action) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs"}[30m])) >= 5

panels.title: HTTP duration by route: mean and p95 (30m window, p95 needs 5 requests)
panels.description: Whole action requests (/v1 routes, health checks excluded), all statuses; p95 needs at least 5 requests in 30 minutes. The gap to LLM duration is AI Card Actions' own work.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (route, le) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m]))) and on (route) sum by (route) (increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_http_request_duration_seconds_count{namespace="ankilabs",route=~"/v1/.+"}[30m])) >= 5

panels.title: LiteLLM duration by model group: mean and p95 (successful calls, 15m buckets)
panels.description: The proxy's own time (provider plus proxy) for successful calls, from LiteLLM's spend logs: exact percentiles, not histogram estimates. Close to LLM duration points at the provider, a larger gap at the in-cluster path.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '15m'), model_group AS metric,
  avg(duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS mean,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY duration_ms) / 1000.0 AS p95
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND status = 'success' AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input size distribution
panels.description: LLM calls per input-size bucket (characters of card text, or of the text to speak) and time slice, darker means more calls. Per-request size and duration are in the llm.request.completed logs.

panels.title: Calls by input size (dashboard range)
panels.description: LLM calls per input-size bucket over the dashboard range; each bar is labelled with its upper bound in characters, +Inf is above 100,000.

panels.title: ai_timeout calls vs mean input size by action
panels.description: ai_timeout calls per bar (left axis) against the mean input characters per call (right axis) for each action. Timeouts rising with input size suggest trimming input before raising the 75 s timeout.

panels.title: Tokens by action and type
panels.description: Prompt and completion tokens per bar, stacked by action to the total, as LiteLLM reported them (including answers rejected afterwards). The dashed line is reasoning tokens, already part of completion: never add it to the stack. Speech reports no tokens.

targets.expr: sum by (action, type) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} offset $__interval) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Cost by action and model
panels.description: LLM cost in USD per bar, stacked by action and model to the total, as LiteLLM reported it (including answers rejected afterwards). Speech is priced per character.

targets.expr: sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__interval) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__interval]))

panels.title: Cost share by action
panels.description: Each action's share of LLM cost over the dashboard range. A sudden shift points at a change in usage or pricing for that action.

panels.title: Cost and tokens by action and model (dashboard range)
panels.description: Total cost and tokens per action and model over the dashboard range, including rejected answers. Tokens are prompt + completion; reasoning is included in them and shown only for scale.

targets.expr: sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_cost_usd_total{namespace="ankilabs"}[$__range]))

sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type=~"prompt|completion"}[$__range]))

sum by (action, model) ((ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"} unless ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"} offset $__range) or increase(ankilabs_ai_card_actions_llm_tokens_total{namespace="ankilabs",type="reasoning"}[$__range]))

panels.title: Usage Codes
panels.description: Every Usage Code from LiteLLM's read-only views, now rather than in the dashboard range: state, spend, budget and the share of it left. Exhausted means spend reached the budget, so LiteLLM rejects its calls; last request includes rejected calls. Authorization's own key is not listed.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT key_alias AS "Usage Code",
  CASE WHEN blocked THEN 'blocked' WHEN expires <= now() THEN 'expired'
    WHEN remaining <= 0 THEN 'exhausted' ELSE 'active' END AS "State",
  spend AS "Spend", max_budget AS "Budget", remaining AS "Remaining",
  greatest(remaining, 0) / nullif(max_budget, 0) AS "Budget left",
  expires AS "Expires", last_request_at AS "Last request", created_at AS "Created",
  array_to_string(models, ', ') AS "Models"
FROM grafana.usage_codes
ORDER BY last_request_at DESC NULLS LAST, key_alias

panels.title: LiteLLM spend by Usage Code / hour
panels.description: LiteLLM spend per Usage Code per hour, stacked to the total: what draws down each code's budget. It should roughly match the Cost panels. Times are stored in UTC and shown in the browser's time zone.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '1h'), coalesce(key_alias, 'unknown key') AS metric,
  sum(spend) AS value
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND spend > 0
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: LiteLLM calls by status / hour
panels.description: Calls LiteLLM logged per hour by status, stacked to the total, including calls it rejected itself (invalid, blocked or exhausted Usage Codes). Failures in red.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(start_time, '1h'), coalesce(status, 'unknown') AS metric,
  count(*) AS value
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest LiteLLM calls (100 in the dashboard range)
panels.description: The 100 most recent LiteLLM calls in the dashboard range with Usage Code, model, status, duration, tokens and spend. The views hold no prompts or answers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT start_time AS "Started", key_alias AS "Usage Code", model_group AS "Model group",
  status AS "Status", duration_ms / 1000.0 AS "Duration", prompt_tokens AS "Prompt tokens",
  completion_tokens AS "Completion tokens", spend AS "Spend"
FROM grafana.spend_logs
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: LLM call warnings and errors: llm.request.completed and llm.output.rejected
panels.description: Each failed call has one llm.request.completed record (error_code, duration_ms, input_chars); a rejected answer adds llm.output.rejected with its reason.

panels.title: AI Card Actions warnings/errors and unparsed records
panels.description: Warning and error records from AI Card Actions, plus records that are not valid JSON. Log records are not a failure count; identifiers are parsed at query time, never indexed.
